title: HtmlDialog
responsibility: Renders the native dialog element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDialog.attributes
inputs.description: Native dialog attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDialog.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native dialog element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDialog
outputs.description: The actual native dialog element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
